ECHELON 1: SPACE (UOV)
SDA PWSA TRANCHE 1/2 TRACKING LAYER + MDA HBTSS FIRE-CONTROL CONSTELLATION
Low Earth Orbit (LEO 400–1,000 km) • "Reagan's SDI Realized in Metal" • Overhead IR/Optical Fire-Control
OVERHEAD FIRE-CONTROL QUALITY TRACKS
• Bypasses Earth curvature and radar horizon limits (d > 400+ km)
• Detects high-altitude aerodynamic, ballistic & hypersonic gliders
• Direct fire-control handover (SM-6, GPI, AMRAAM) without ground radar
SDA Tranche 1/2 WFOV + HBTSS MFOV Precision Tracking
OPTICAL INTERSATELLITE LINKS (OISL)
• 10 Gbps cross-link laser mesh: zero radio-frequency footprint
• Sub-second global track distribution across proliferated LEO constellation
• Immune to terrestrial surface electronic warfare and GPS jamming
Space-to-Air Direct Tactical Link • Non-Geostationary Mesh
DEFEATING RADAR HORIZON BLINDNESS
• Surface radars blind below horizon: d ≈ 4.12·(√h_radar + √h_target)
• Overhead look-down geometry eliminates terrain shadowing completely
• Queues airborne "flying batteries" prior to target radar line-of-sight
Pre-Horizon Intercept Geometry • SDI Evolution Benchmark
Space-to-Air Fire-Control Track < 200 ms

AUTONOMOUS FLYING MISSILE BATTERY (HEAVY CCA) + NON-STOP AAR REFUELING
Standoff Orbit: FL300–FL350 (80–120 km behind FLOT) • MQ-28A Ghost Bat Block 3 / AIM-120 • MQ-25 / CRONUS Loop
MQ-28 GHOST BAT: FLYING MAGAZINE
• Woomera Dec 2025 Test Precedent: successful live AIM-120 AMRAAM firing
• Block 3 Expansion: enlarged wing + internal bays (AIM-120 / SDB GBU-39)
• Operates as "Missile Truck" releasing kinetic salvos on space/off-board cues
• Exercise Valiant Shield 2026: multi-domain teaming alongside F-22 & F-35
Internal Carriage Stealth • Autonomous Standoff Magazine
AUTONOMOUS AERIAL REFUELING (AAR)
• MQ-25A Stingray: operational flight April 2026 (VUQ-11 carrier integration)
• AFRL CRONUS: Boom Automation + RelNav (Relative Navigation) uncrewed loop
• Continuous Combat Air Patrol (CAP): non-stop endurance without aircrew fatigue
• Enables deep penetration strike analogous to B-1B / B-21 long-range bomber
Automated Boom Rendezvous • Pacific Theater Range Extension
COST-EXCHANGE RATIO INVERSION
• Replaces $300M crewed NGAD with $12M–$18M attritable flying batteries
• Fires long-range interceptors from outside adversary SAM engagement zones
• Offloads sensing to space/ground-clutter: platform remains clean and survivable
• Neutralizes adversary air dominance without risking allied aviators
Asymmetric Air Dominance • Unmanned Missile Carrier
Cross-Domain LEO Data Fabric & Direct-to-Cell
ECHELON 3: DATA FABRIC
DIRECT-TO-CELL LEO SATCOM + DISTRIBUTED EDGE-TO-CLOUD AI BACKBONE
Bypassing Line-of-Sight (LOS) Radio Collapse in Ground Clutter • Anti-Jam Telemetry • Open Mission Systems (OMS/UCI)
OVERCOMING LINE-OF-SIGHT (LOS) COLLAPSE
• Traditional airborne radio (Link 16) fails when drones drop behind terrain
• Direct-to-Cell / LEO micro-links maintain continuous orbital connectivity
• Real-time low-bandwidth telemetry + burst optical video on final dive
Eliminates Line-of-Sight Blindness • Starshield / Cellular Hybrid
DISTRIBUTED AI VS. ONBOARD MONOLITH
• Monolithic onboard AI causes avionics computational bottlenecking in swarms
• Edge-AI on platform handles microsecond stabilization & optical lock
• Heavy multi-agent swarm allocation offloaded to space/cloud compute
Two-Tier Compute Architecture • Low-SWaP Attritable Avionics
UNMANNED WARFARE ENGINE (UWE HAL)
• Software Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) on POSIX/CCSDS interfaces
• Translates CJADC2 / DAF Battle Network missions to diverse effector swarms
• Defeats prime-contractor vendor lock-in for the Pentagon's Replicator
Interoperable Cross-Domain Bridge • Zero Vendor Lock-in
Terminal Swarm Vectoring (0–300m Clutter Ingress)
ECHELON 4: CLUTTER (UCV)
TACTICAL COMBAT COPTERS (UCV), LOITERING UAVS & "ZHDUN" SLEEPER AMBUSH
Ground-Clutter Envelope: 0–300 m AGL • Doppler Notch (V_radial ≤ 25 m/s) • Neutralizing NATO Class I & II IADS
NATO CLASS I & II TARGET ELIMINATION
• Class I Targets (<150 kg): FPV launch teams, MANPADS posts, tactical squads
• Class II Targets (150–600 kg): 9S18M1 Kupol radar masts, Tor/Buk mobile SAMs
• Johnson's DRI resolution: millimeter target identification under tree canopy
• Proves mission formula: E_recon = f(R_detect, clutter) >> f(H_ceiling)
Terrain Masking Penetration • Clutter Dominance
"ZHDUN" (SLEEPER) GROUND AMBUSH
• Forward perching on treelines/rooftops: ultra-low power standby (<5 mA)
• Zero acoustic and thermal signature: completely invisible to adversary IRST
• Rapid launch in 1.5 s upon radar emission cue from Space/Standoff layer
• Terminal dive attack at 120–160 km/h: absolute ECCM immunity (fiber/Edge-AI)
Repositionable Minefield • Sub-Second Reactive Ambush
THE CYBER-PHYSICAL UCV STANDARD
• Retires hobbyist "FPV" slang for formal Unmanned Copter Vehicle (UCV)
• Dynamic thrust-to-weight T/W ≥ 2.5: terminal dive ballistics in crosswinds
• MIL-STD-1316 certified electronic safe-and-arm modular warhead trains
• High-discharge 21700 cylindrical cells (45–60C burst) for aggressive egress
Industrial Scalability • Certified Combat Readiness
CENTRAL DOCTRINAL IMPERATIVE
"DRONES KILL DRONES" — DE-CENTERING THE HUMAN PILOT (THE SOLDIER PARADIGM)
Direct doctrinal parallel to the iconic military principle: "Soldiers kill soldiers." In 21st-century contested peer warfare, machines must autonomously fight machines.
THE LEGACY PILOT-CENTRIC TRAP
• Single-seat F-35 pilot forced to act as airborne drone manager under enemy fire
• Mitchell Institute Study (H. Penney): severe cognitive saturation collapses decision loop
• Mission duration strictly tethered to pilot physical endurance (dehydration, G-force fatigue)
• Single Point of Failure: destroying or jamming the crewed leader eliminates entire swarm
THE UWE MACHINE-TO-MACHINE PARADIGM
• Humans establish strategic Rules of Engagement (ROE) and high-level mission intent
• Tactical kill web executes machine-to-machine at microsecond wire speed (< 1.5 sec)
• Autonomous Flying Batteries (MQ-28/AIM-120) engage hostile drones without pilot cueing
• Non-stop persistent patrols: rotating AAR-refueled uncrewed magazines sanitize airspace
